skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the content, meaning, scientific basis, methods, and steps for establishing and adjusting land use plans at all levels.
Analyze and explain knowledge to implement steps in the land use planning process.
Explain and apply knowledge to evaluate the implementation of land use planning indicators at all levels.
Know how to apply knowledge to establish land use plans at various levels and assess the implementation of land use planning indicators.
Have the ability to self-study, find materials to complete assigned lessons and assignments.
Have leadership and professional influence in land management activities; have innovative ideas in completing assigned tasks; have the ability to direct and adapt to different working environments.
